replies.author: _Mx_
replies.body:
As a non-donor, I feel as though a 1-5 player difference will not effect my general gameplay. I understand that it can be an irritating predicament when it's above a 5 player difference, but it generally won't matter too much. You're always welcome to call friends, and this even will be rare.

I feel as though the only issue would be if the people team stacking were experienced, veteran players. But for the following reasons, I doubt this would usually happen.

- The veterans are usually kind people - at least, in my experience, they want to play clean. They wouldn't team stack, at least not try to.

- Some of them are already donators. I've seen plenty of veterans join the other team as soon as a big player difference occurs. 

I don't personally think that Team Stacking should be bannable. After all, it's a rather rare occurrence.

EDIT: This is all in my experience  - I am not making hasty generalizations. This is based off of what I have seen, you may experience it differently.
